title: A Oath for the Wolf
author: Hazel Thackeray
blurb: Hazel Okonkwo, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
